insight: Acquired by Cisco in April 2026 and folded into Splunk as 'Splunk Agent Observability.'
name: Galileo
tagline: Evaluation and observability for GenAI apps and agents, with inline guardrails.
description: A platform for testing, monitoring, and guardrailing LLM and agent applications. It ships 20+ out-of-the-box evals for RAG, agents, and safety, lets teams author custom evaluators, and turns those offline evals into real-time production guardrails powered by its own Luna eval models.

changelog.summary: Acquired by Cisco (Apr 2026), now Splunk Agent Observability; rewrote insight to the acquisition and removed galileo.ai/pricing (now redirects to Splunk).

edge: Turns offline evals into real-time production guardrails powered by its own cheap Luna eval models, not an LLM judge.
pros: 20+ out-of-the-box evals for RAG and agents
Inline runtime guardrails, not just offline scoring
Own Luna models keep eval costs low
cons: Pricing tiers gate the production guardrails
Proprietary eval models, not open source
Heavier setup than a drop-in proxy
